name: Tribology: Friction, Wear & Lubrication
summary: Explains how surfaces in contact interact, why parts wear out, and how materials and lubricants are chosen to control friction and wear.

topics.name: Contact mechanics: Hertzian contact and real area of contact
Friction laws and mechanisms: adhesion, ploughing and stick-slip
Wear mechanisms: adhesive, abrasive, erosive, fatigue and corrosive wear; Archard's law
Lubrication regimes: boundary, mixed, elastohydrodynamic and hydrodynamic; the Stribeck curve
Lubricants and additives; solid lubricants (MoS2, graphite, PTFE)
Tribology in vacuum and space mechanisms
Tribology of polymers, ceramics and biomedical joints
